title: Autonomous TSecBench loop
description: You own the full loop without human help. Use pnpm tsecbench list/status/start/submit/close. Rules: (1) max 3 concurrent started containers; (2) prefer incomplete medium then hard; (3) skip already is_completed=true; (4) after each flag submit, close that challenge; (5) if container broken, close then start again; (6) VPN is already connected—never hunt VPN or change host routes; (7) write every cycle under evidence/tsec/<code>/ with board.json, recon-*.txt, submit-*.json; (8) keep going across multiple challenges until budget ends. Hint costs score—avoid unless truly stuck.

title: Maintain progress log
description: Keep evidence/goals/autonomous-progress.md updated with which unique_codes completed, scores awarded, and next planned code.
